source: yfinance public option chain for SPY
settlement: physical delivery of shares (US equity/ETF options)
expiry_time_assumption: 20:00 UTC on expiry date (approx. 16:00 New York; ignores DST)
quote_timestamp_note: yfinance gives lastTradeDate per contract, not a quote timestamp; bid/ask and spot are delayed and not synchronised. 'quote_time' is left empty; staleness can only be judged from last_trade_time.
label: MARKET_DELAYED - not live, not synchronised
rate_assumption: none stored; supply r explicitly downstream
